1.consolidated_definition: Prenda interior femenina que consiste en dos medias altas de tejido fino y elástico que suben hasta la cintura a modo de pantalón ajustado.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Feminine undergarment consisting of two high stockings made of fine and elastic fabric that rise to the waist in the form of a tight-fitting pant.
